# of controller/internal/nodesim/scale.go with 10,000 nodes, 1,000 VRFs and 100,000 routes, as .github/scripts/bench-gate.py reads
# them: <case> <median> <unit> <margin %>.
# The step Performance regression gate at the target of the job scale in ranz.yml compares the BENCH lines of each run of the full
# set with them.
# bench-gate.py record makes this file from the scale-bench*.txt files of the artifact ranz-scale-full of several CI runs.
# Recorded by bench-gate.py record from 2 runs of the job scale (ubuntu-24.04, 4 CPUs) on pull request 603, 41302590647 and
# 41322803714, the margin twice the slowest run's distance from the median, rounded up to 5 %, and at least 75 %: the apply of the
# slower run took 32 % longer than that of the faster, so a run 75 % slower than its median is a regression and not a noisy
# runner. Record them again from more runs of the full set (each night makes one) to narrow the margins.
